description:
Map lane: everything inside a bounding box — THE SCREEN (relays GET /api/v1/map.viewport). Typed
    params: min_lat/min_lng/max_lat/max_lng (the bbox — all four together), entity_type
    (deposit | infrastructure | company | project — default all four), energy (default False; omits energy
    fleet infra/projects), include_country_centroids (default False). Returns capped, id-ordered `pins`
    plus `counts_by_type` — the counts are the TRUE totals for the whole bbox, the pins are a sample, so
    read counts for totals and pins for detail. AGENT KEYS ONLY (a non-agent credential is refused BEFORE
    any charge); a per-owner viewport rate window applies. Each named pin, and each operator it names, counts
    against your monthly entity cap like look_from's pins: pins past the cap are cut (the answer's `entity_cap`
    says how many) and the charge follows the pins delivered; nothing is charged when no pin fits.
    ONE `basic` price per call. Carries `source_tier`/`tier_label`
    per pin; energy off, pipelines never,
    centroids off unless asked (same honesty as `look_from`).Metered: charged to your own wallet — see the server instructions (CHARGING); quote first with `billing_quote`.

energy.description: Include energy-fleet infrastructure and projects. Default false.
energy.title: Energy

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. Default all four.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

include_country_centroids.description: Also return country-centre placeholder pins (entities known only by country). Default false.
include_country_centroids.title: Include Country Centroids

max_lat.description: North edge of the bounding box (latitude).
max_lat.title: Max Lat

max_lng.description: East edge of the bounding box (longitude).
max_lng.title: Max Lng

min_lat.description: South edge of the bounding box (latitude). Send all four edges together.
min_lat.title: Min Lat

min_lng.description: West edge of the bounding box (longitude).
min_lng.title: Min Lng

name: map_viewport
